calibration_summary: LPDDR5 defines several system / lab-level calibration and training loops: (1) ZQ calibration — trim DRAM output-driver and ODT impedance against an external precision reference resistor on the ZQ pin; (2) WCK2CK synchronization — lock the DRAM's internal full-speed Write Clock (WCK) phase to the quarter-speed CK before high-speed transfers (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR via CAS); (3) read training — using the RDCAL fixed pattern / Read FIFO, the controller sweeps DQ + RDQS sampling phase (with DFE) to find the optimal read eye; (4) write training — using the Write FIFO, the controller trains the WCK-relative write eye; (5) Vref training — Vref(ca)/Vref(dq) trim per frequency set point. These loops must be re-run after a DVFS frequency-set-point change and after deep-sleep exit.

zq_calibration_procedure.purpose: Trim DRAM output-driver impedance and on-die termination against an external precision reference resistor to compensate Process / Voltage / Temperature drift.
zq_calibration_procedure.prerequisites: Device in the appropriate idle state; DQ bus idle on the affected device(s) during the calibration window.
zq_calibration_procedure.external_reference: External precision resistor between the ZQ pin and ground (per JESD209-5).
zq_calibration_procedure.commands: ZQ calibration start / latch issued via MPC (multi-purpose command) per the LPDDR5 calibration flow.
zq_calibration_procedure.error_recovery: If impedance drifts beyond spec, re-run ZQ calibration; for severe drift, retrain at the active frequency set point.

wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.purpose: Phase-lock the DRAM's internal WCK to the quarter-speed CK so that read/write data timing is deterministic at full speed.
wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.trigger: Required at initialization, before high-speed transfers, after DVFS frequency change, and after deep-sleep exit.

options.use: Free-start; start WCK immediately, may precede multiple reads/writes across banks.
Read-optimized; optimize WCK timing for an immediately following read.
Write-optimized; optimize WCK timing for an immediately following write.

wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.carried_by: CAS (Column Address Select) command on the CA bus.
wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.error_recovery: If the WCK eye is not centered, adjust WCK phase / leveling and re-issue the synchronization.

read_training_procedure.purpose: Find the optimal DQ sampling phase relative to the DRAM-driven RDQS at the active data rate.
read_training_procedure.prerequisites: WCK locked to CK; DFE / equalization configured for the frequency set point.
procedure: 1. Issue Read DQ Calibration (RDCAL) / read the internal FIFO to obtain a deterministic pattern.
2. Sweep the controller's DQ sampling phase across the bit window with the configured DFE taps.
3. Compare the received pattern to the expected calibration pattern per phase; record the pass window.
4. Pick the window center as the read sampling phase.
read_training_procedure.error_recovery: If no pass window is found, re-run ZQ calibration / WCK2CK sync, adjust DFE taps and Vref(dq), or reduce the frequency set point.

write_training_procedure.purpose: Center the controller-driven WCK / DQ write eye at the DRAM's sampling point.
procedure: 1. Use the Write FIFO to load a known pattern through the write path without disturbing the array.
2. Sweep WCK-to-DQ phase and Vref(dq); read back to validate; pick the best write phase.
write_training_procedure.error_recovery: Adjust WCK leveling, output-driver impedance, and Vref(dq); retrain.

dvfs_retraining: After a frequency-set-point (FSP) change (DVFS / DVFSC selecting VDD2H/VDD2L), the controller must re-run ZQ calibration, WCK2CK synchronization, read training, and write training for the new operating point, applying the FSP-specific RL/WL/ODT/Vref/DFE values.
no_analog_trim_at_bus_interface: LPDDR5 SDRAM does not expose user-accessible analog trim/fuse registers at the bus interface. Internal DRAM array trim, sense-amp bias, charge-pump levels, and the on-die WCK clock generator are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope of JESD209-5.

power_up_characterization.supply_ramp_order: VDD1 (~1.8 V) → VDD2H/VDD2L → VDDQ (0.5 V) per JESD209-5.
power_up_characterization.initial_calibration: ZQ calibration + initial WCK2CK synchronization + read/write training required before normal operation.
power_up_characterization.deep_sleep_exit: Full re-initialization (including ZQ + WCK2CK + training) required.

notes: The ZQ, WCK2CK, read-training, write-training, and Vref loops are host-controlled closed loops with on-die assistance — the DRAM exposes the feedback mechanisms (ZQ engine, RDCAL pattern, Read/Write FIFO, WCK leveling) and the controller drives the iteration. JESD209-5 standardizes the mechanisms; the iteration algorithm and scheduling are vendor / controller-IP-specific. The defining LPDDR5 addition versus DDR3 is the on-demand WCK clock requiring explicit WCK2CK synchronization before every high-speed transfer burst group.
